_comment: Quick-reference used by the checker to label citations it finds in a letter. It is NOT a substitute for the bare Act. Entries marked verify=true were amended recently or have conditions; always confirm against https://cbic-gst.gov.in (GST Acts / Rules / Circulars). Edit or extend this file freely - the notebook reloads it every run.
